newsitem.title: CHINA: China says no timetable on joining WTO.
newsitem.headline: China says no timetable on joining WTO.

text.p: Chinese Trade Minister Wu Yi said Beijing had no timetable on entry to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) and that the matter was out of China's hands, the China News Service said on Tuesday.
"On the question of when China can gain entry into the WTO, China itself has no timetable, because the initiative is not in China's hands," the agency quoted Wu as saying on Monday.
"China's stance and attitude on entering the World Trade Organisation has not changed," Wu said in a meeting with high-level foreign trade officials.
Beijing had already made great strides in meeting entry terms by reforming its foreign currency exchange system years ahead of schedule, Wu said.
China would not accept entry conditions that were out of line with its economic situation, she said.
Beijing has sought acceptance to the WTO under the easier terms accorded developing nations, but many countries, notably the United States, have insisted China enter as a developed country.
